mapper.select: SELECT act02_journal_id AS journal_id , act02_date AS date , act02_journal_no AS journal_no , act02_corp_id AS corp_id , f_get_journal_corp_nm(act02_journal_id) AS corp_name , f_cdnm('trCode', f_get_journal_tr_cd(act02_journal_id), act02_company_id, act02_date) AS tr_name , act02_note AS note , COALESCE(act02_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS fix_yn FROM act02_journal WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_journal_id = #{journalId}

SELECT act06_journal_tmp_id AS journal_tmp_id , act06_seq AS seq , act06_drcr_type AS drcr_type , f_cdnm('DrcrType', act06_drcr_type, act02_company_id, act02_date) AS drcr_type_name , act06_real_account_cd AS real_account_code , f_get_account_nm(act02_company_id, act06_real_account_cd) AS real_account_name , act06_repr_account_cd AS repr_account_code , act06_account_map AS account_map , act06_amt AS amt , act06_for_amt AS for_amt , act06_deposit_id AS deposit_id , f_ast_class_tree_nm(act06_deposit_id) AS deposit_name , act06_note AS note FROM act02_journal INNER JOIN act06_journal_tmp ON act06_journal_id = act02_journal_id WHERE act02_journal_id = #{journalId} ORDER BY act06_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO act06_journal_tmp (act06_journal_tmp_id, act06_journal_id, act06_seq, act06_repr_account_cd, act06_real_account_cd, act06_drcr_type, act06_amt, act06_deposit_id, act06_note, act06_account_map, act06_for_amt) VALUES (#{tmpId}, #{journalId}, #{seq}, #{r.reprAccountCode}, #{r.realAccountCode}, #{r.drcrType}, COALESCE(#{r.amt}, 0), #{r.depositId}, #{r.note}, #{r.accountMap}, COALESCE(#{r.forAmt}, 0))

INSERT INTO act03_journal_dtl SELECT f_create_seq() , #{journalId} , #{seq} , CAST(#{dr.realAccountCode} AS varchar) , COALESCE(CAST(#{dr.amt} AS numeric), 0) , CAST(#{cr.realAccountCode} AS varchar) , COALESCE(CAST(#{cr.amt} AS numeric), 0) , CAST(#{dr.depositId} AS numeric) , CAST(#{cr.depositId} AS numeric) , CAST(#{dr.note} AS varchar) , CAST(#{cr.note} AS varchar) , COALESCE(CAST(#{dr.forAmt} AS numeric), 0) , COALESCE(CAST(#{cr.forAmt} AS numeric), 0)
